annotations.title: Get a mailbox's warmup by day

description: Get this mailbox's warmup one day at a time, on the workspace's calendar, today included: what it sent and the day's cap, how much of it partners found and how much of that was in spam, and what partners sent it, how much landed in spam and how much it moved back to the inbox. The last 30 days, or `days` (90 at most). The mailbox's warmup field says where it stands now.

days.description: How many days back to read, today included, 1 to 90. Left out, 30.
